title: Towards Inclusive NLP: Assessing Compressed Multilingual Transformers across Diverse Language Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot accuracy and confidence scores on multiple-choice knowledge benchmarks (EnglishMMLU, ArabicMMLU, and Indic-Benchmark/Kannada-ARC-C-2.5K) to quantify performance disparities and linguistic biases between high-resource (English) and low-resource (Arabic, Kannada) languages, particularly under various model compression settings.
